meta.title: Metro Atlanta / Georgia Hard Money & Private Money Lenders
meta.disclaimer: Fields are taken from publicly available lender websites as of the verification date. Rates, LTVs, and terms change; always confirm directly with the lender. This is not lending, financial, or legal advice.
meta.geography_focus: Metro Atlanta and State of Georgia
meta.last_refresh_note: 2026-10-30 refresh: Lima One, Kiavi, and Georgia Private Lending re-verified against live pages (no rate/term changes; Lima One contact/NMLS details added). 100PLD re-checked and still offline (HTTP 503 on 2026-10-27, 2026-10-29, and 2026-10-30; the 2026-10-30 response carried an 'x-suspended-vhost' header) — row kept with its 2026-10-27 date and a visible warning. Other rows keep their 2026-10-29 verified dates.

lenders.name: Georgia Private Lending
lenders.terms: 6–12 months (published); origination 1–4%; rates listed 12–14% (subject to change)
lenders.min_credit_experience: No minimum asset/income requirements; decisions based primarily on borrower experience and subject property
lenders.notes: Local Atlanta hard money; SFR and small multifamily; investment properties only. In-house approval process. Office: 750 Hammond Dr Bldg. 5 Suite 300, Atlanta, GA 30328.

lenders.name: AHP Capital
lenders.ltv_leverage: Typical hard money up to ~75% ARV (fix-and-flip); cash-out refinance up to 70% of current value
lenders.terms: Fix-and-flip: rates from as low as 9%, terms six months to a year (vary with project and borrower history); new construction typically ~1 year; fix-and-keep can convert to an 8% fixed 30-year (or other) loan via a licensed mortgage partner
lenders.min_credit_experience: Not published as a hard minimum; terms vary with project and borrower experience
lenders.notes: Metro Atlanta lender for 25+ years; homepage advertises "Zero money down payments. 9% interest-only." Claims ability to close many rescue deals in just two days. Office: 755 Commerce Drive, Suite 803, Decatur, GA 30030.

lenders.name: Fairview Commercial Lending
lenders.areas_served: Entire state of Georgia (emphasis on Atlanta metro, north GA, Savannah); also CO and FL
lenders.ltv_leverage: Up to 55% of property value (purchase based on purchase price)
lenders.terms: Up to 10 years; closings typically 5–10 days; loans as small as ~$50k
lenders.min_credit_experience: No minimum credit score; asset-based / no-doc style underwriting on collateral
lenders.notes: Privately funded direct lender since 1975; states no upfront fees and no appraisal required (in-house underwriting). Marietta office: 3535 Roswell Road Ste 57, Marietta, GA 30062; Atlanta office line (404) 634-1270.

lenders.name: 100PLD (100Percent Lender Direct)
lenders.areas_served: Metro Atlanta and surrounding Georgia counties (Fulton, Cobb, DeKalb, Gwinnett, Douglas cited)
lenders.ltv_leverage: Advertises up to 100% of acquisition and renovation costs on fix-and-flip and construction (deal/ARV based)
lenders.terms: Fix-and-flip and bridge typically 6–18 months; construction aligns with build timeline
lenders.min_credit_experience: Works with experienced investors; not designed for first-time buyers/beginners (per FAQ)
lenders.notes: Direct private lender positioning (no broker layer). Address listed: 7421 Douglas Blvd Unit N #418, Douglasville, GA 30135. CAUTION: 100pld.com returned HTTP 503 'Site Currently Unavailable' on live checks on 2026-10-27, 2026-10-29, and 2026-10-30; the 2026-10-30 response included an 'x-suspended-vhost' header, which indicates the web hosting account is suspended. Fields come from search-indexed copies of the home/FAQ/about/contact pages. Not live-verified — confirm the company is operating and confirm terms directly before relying on anything here.
lenders.status_flag: Website offline on 3 checks (10/27, 10/29, 10/30) — not live-verified

lenders.name: Silliman Private Lending
lenders.areas_served: Based in Atlanta/Roswell; states lending throughout the United States
lenders.ltv_leverage: Qualifications list cites minimum/up to ~70% ARV
lenders.terms: Fix-and-flip 6 or 12 months; rates as low as 10%; origination as low as 2% ($2,500 minimum origination fee); extensions at 1% per month; transactional: 3-day term, 1% origination, 0% interest
lenders.min_credit_experience: Prior flip or rental experience; reserves (~$30k depending on deal); strong comps and exit plan; $500 application fee may apply
lenders.notes: Lends own funds; specializes in SFR flips roughly $100k–$1M. Office: 900 Old Roswell Lakes Parkway Suite 230, Roswell, GA 30076.

lenders.name: Atlanta Private Lending
lenders.ltv_leverage: True hard money / rehab: up to 70% ARV; purchase up to 65% LTV; cash-out refinance 50–60% LTV
lenders.terms: Hard money up to 12 months; rates starting ~12%; fees 2–4%; min loan often $100k (1st lien)
lenders.min_credit_experience: No minimum credit score on hard money products; experience preferred but not required
lenders.notes: Also maintains rehabatl.com / hardmoneyatlanta.com pages. Investment / non-owner-occupied only. Close in as little as 10 days (claimed); ARV appraisal by lender-approved appraiser, paid by borrower. New construction listed from 11% / 2% fees.

lenders.name: Mainspring Lending (Mainspring Capital)
lenders.areas_served: Atlanta-based; areas beyond Atlanta not clearly limited on site
lenders.ltv_leverage: Fix-and-flip / bridge: up to 90% LTC and up to 80% LTV; new construction: up to 85% LTC / 75% LTV
lenders.terms: Fix-and-flip: loans $50k–$5M, 6, 12, or 24 months; bridge up to 12 months, interest as low as 11%; origination as low as 2%; close in as little as 48 hours (claimed)
lenders.min_credit_experience: 620 credit score cited for fix-and-flip/bridge; no prior projects necessary for fix-and-flip; new construction requires prior successful projects
lenders.notes: PO Box: 650 Ponce de Leon Ave ste 300 #2135, Atlanta, GA 30308. Contact via website form.

lenders.name: Peach Tree Commercial Capital
lenders.areas_served: Marietta / Atlanta-area lender (statewide footprint not fully detailed on fix-and-flip page)
lenders.terms: 6, 9, or 12 months on tabulated program (narrative text also says 12–18 months); rate listed 9.50%; min loan $50K (1–4 units) / $250K (5+ / mixed use); max $2MM (1–4) / $3MM (5+)
lenders.min_credit_experience: FICO 660 typical; 640–659 may require interest reserves; new and seasoned investors accepted
lenders.notes: Office: 2551 Roswell Road, Suite 525, Marietta, GA 30062. Narrative says up to 95% of purchase + 100% of renovation, capped at 75% ARV. Interest only on draws; no prepayment penalty listed on program table. Publishes a broker/partner program page.

lenders.name: Kiavi
lenders.ltv_leverage: Up to 100% of purchase + 100% of rehab, up to 80% ARV (headline 100% LTC; FAQ cites up to 95% LTC)
lenders.terms: 12, 18, or 24 months with interest-only options; loans from ~$100k to $5MM; rates advertised from 8.25%
lenders.min_credit_experience: Not fully published on fix-and-flip overview; property-based pricing emphasized; no income verification claimed
lenders.notes: National tech-enabled lender with in-house valuation/servicing. No application fee / no appraisal claims on fix-and-flip page. Confirm GA product availability at quote time.

lenders.name: Lima One Capital
lenders.areas_served: Georgia statewide including Atlanta metro (Cobb, DeKalb, Douglas, etc.), Athens, Savannah, Gainesville, Macon
lenders.ltv_leverage: Not published on Georgia marketing pages reviewed
lenders.terms: Not published as a single table on GA pages; product-specific — request quote
lenders.min_credit_experience: Approvals consider investor credit and experience (exact minimums not published on GA pages)
lenders.notes: National private money lender lending in Atlanta since 2010 per its Georgia page; NMLS #1324403; HQ 300 East McBee Ave, Suite 200, Greenville, SC 29601. Does not lend in AK, ND, SD, or VT. Backed by MFA Financial (REIT) per site. Publishes mortgage-broker and referral partner programs. LTV/terms not published on the GA page — request a quote.

lenders.name: Groundfloor Lending
lenders.areas_served: 35 states for most products; new construction and DSCR in all 50 states (Georgia HQ; GA included in footprint)
lenders.ltv_leverage: Not published as a single max on FAQ; funding based on property and ARV
lenders.terms: Loans $75,000–$3.5M; typically 6–18 months (DSCR 30-year fixed options); rates from ~9.25% (fix-and-flip) and 5.875% (DSCR) per FAQ; deferred OR monthly interest options
lenders.min_credit_experience: Minimum credit score 640; no bankruptcies/foreclosures in recent lookback window; 18+ with property under contract
lenders.notes: Atlanta-based. FAQ cites $495 application fee, underwriting fee 1%–3.75%, $1,250 closing costs; no prepayment penalty after first 3 months (3-month minimum interest). Close in as few as 7 business days (most 7–14) claimed.
